level1_releases.name: Hermes Agent v0.23.3
level1_releases.body_excerpt:
# Hermes Agent v0.23.3

**Release Date:** November 19, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~370 PRs merged since v0.23.2 into a stable release for the GitHub release (CLI and installers), the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.24.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## About this release

Measured at commit `caafe5389ae`, the window since v0.23.2 contains **1,657 non-merge commits** across **3,948 changed files** (+222,379 / −96,154), **370 merged PRs** and **60 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: one prompt-cache lifecycle controller (warming through long tool runs, compaction of idle chats before the 1h cache expires, Nous Portal on the full 1h lifecycle, `prompt_caching.cache_ttl` defaulting to `auto`), compaction that archives the tool results it drops, the proactive tool-result prune on by default, a one-question first-run CLI setup with the free tier included, GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol (+ Pro) on OpenRouter and Nous Portal, a "Waiting on teammates" strip above Bot Chat composers, the Linux AppImage agent payload run from a stable per-build copy, the storage layer split behind a persistence interface with its SQLite backend, dependency security bumps (oauthlib, opentelemetry, tornado), and a large batch of new plugin-catalog entries.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.24.0**, which will document everything from v0.23.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.23.2...v0.23.3](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.23.2...v0.23.3)

## New Features

- Added GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra to model catalogs, with Sol as the default catalog selection. (#62106)
- Enabled the TUI workspace by default, with searchable document previews, image previews, and subagent transcripts alongside the main conversation. (#61352, #61888, #61889, #61919, #62157)
- Added configurable undo and redo shortcuts to the non-Vim prompt composer, including restoration of attachments and large pastes. (#61954)
- Added `codex exec --remote <ADDR>` to start or resume noninteractive sessions on an existing app server. (#61707)
- Added `/rc` and `/remote` to manage local remote control and display device pairing codes from the TUI. (#62121)
- Added custom MCP status line selection and authoring through `/statusline` when `tui_extensions_statusline` is enabled. (#61979, #61988, #62037)

## Bug Fixes

- Preserved drafts, queued follow-ups, and interrupted input with their original threads when switching or resuming sessions. (#61216)
- Kept permission profiles intact when changing working directories. (#61195)
- Prevented late completion events from cancelling approvals for a newer turn. (#61801)
- Preserved earlier edits in aggregate diffs when steering an active turn. (#61820)
- Fixed scrolling that inserted stray characters, composer caret jumps, and redraws using stale terminal dimensions. (#62139, #62174, #62175)
- Fixed enterprise MCP sign-in for identity providers that issue ID tokens without refresh tokens. (#62129)

## Chores

- Updated source builds and release tooling to Rust 1.99.1. (#61205)
- Updated XML dependencies and removed obsolete security advisory exceptions. (#62068)

## Changelog

Full Changelog: https://github.com/openai/codex/compare/rust-v0.170.0...rust-v0.171.0

- #61178 Enable conversation-scoped speed selection for Cloud turns @bc-openai
- #61180 Reclaim abandoned trusted Git repositories @etraut-openai
- #61181 Fix pagination for unindexed threads sorted by ascending recency @etraut-openai
- #61182 Support renaming cloud threads @bc-openai
- #61183 Fix fork parent metadata in reconstructed TUI sessions @fcoury-oai
- #61185 Defer Guardian context limits to request preparation @ioanbudea-OAI
- #61186 Keep plan item IDs unique after completion @neerajrj-oai

- #61194 Remove redundant legacy permission helpers @ioanbudea-OAI

level1_releases.name: v2.1.329
level1_releases.body_excerpt:
## What's changed

- Added a trust dialog warning that says where a folder's hooks are declared
- Added a warning in the conversation, in Claude Desktop and other non-interactive hosts, when hooks in managed settings fail to load
- Added this session's scheduled tasks, `/loop` wakeups, the goal and this conversation's forks to `/tasks`; x stops one after asking
- Added a "Server message" row to a server's page in `/mcp` that shows the JSON-RPC error message of a remote HTTP MCP server that refuses the connection
- Added a "Marketplace auto-update" row to `/status` that names managed marketplaces that get no automatic updates, and why
- Added support for turning on Code Mode while OpenTelemetry events and metrics are enabled; each tool call the code makes sends its events; tracing still keeps it off
- Fixed `~/.claude.json` sometimes being reset to defaults when a network stall or file lock made it unreadable and cleared during a save
- Fixed repeated sign-outs on macOS when Claude Code could read the Keychain but not save to it. That session now stops at expiry and says why, and other sessions stay signed in
- Fixed `/terminal-setup` corrupting VS Code settings or keybindings files around block comments, and reporting success while losing the Shift+Enter binding where keybindings.json has an unclosed string
- Fixed files accepted through the IDE diff being saved without their last newline, and losing their byte order mark (BOM) when an edit was accepted by saving the diff in VS Code
- Fixed picking a cloud session in `/teleport` replacing your open conversation: the pick now starts a new session, as `/clear` does, and `/resume` brings the old one back
- Fixed `/usage-credits` asking Pro and Max users to log in again after opening the browser, and the link disappearing after 8 seconds if the browser doesn't open and a task stops for usage credits
- Fixed `/usage` saying usage credits are off when they had run out or reached the monthly limit, and `/model` not telling Pro and Max users when that limit blocks a model that runs on usage credits
- Fixed the spend limit menu showing your spend as your monthly limit and wrapping its rows under the pointer in narrow windows
- Fixed a status line script that prints without end freezing the prompt and using gigabytes of memory
- Fixed an empty, frozen screen after approving managed settings while the --resume picker, the trust dialog or another set-up screen was waiting
- Fixed choosing Default in `/model` replacing
